<details open>

server: slot_sched: fix lora and recurrent (#32434)

* server: fix lora and recurrent

* tests: run the hybrid SWA checkpoint test with one token per ubatch

With and without the cache, the prompt was not split into the same
ubatches, and the generated tokens are decoded one at a time while the
uncached run processes them in a batch. On CUDA this moves the top
logprobs of the tiny model by up to 0.03 and swaps near ties, so the
test failed while the cache behaved as expected.

With one token per ubatch both runs go through the same kernels and
the output is compared exactly.

---------

Co-authored-by: Pascal <admin@serveurperso.com>

</details>

<details open>

cuda: use the implicit GEMM conv2d path for F32 kernels (#32482)

The fast CONV_2D path (implicit GEMM with MMA, or cuBLAS for
pointwise convolutions) required an F16 kernel. F32 kernels fell
back to the naive direct convolution, which is much slower than
im2col + mul_mat on large channel counts.

Convert F32 kernels to F16 in a pool buffer, as is already done for
the input, and take the same path with F32 accumulation. The Metal
implicit GEMM kernel already stages both operands as F16.

</details>
